newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P rates Peabody Finance CP A-1.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P rates Peabody Finance CP A-1.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Thursday it had assigned its A-1 rating to Peabody Finance Ltd's commercial paper issued under the company's A$400 million commercial paper and medium term note programme.
Commercial paper issued by Peabody Finance is guaranteed by The Energy Group Plc, also rated A-1.
The Energy Group, a diversified global energy business with substantial interests in coal, power generation and distribution, was formed following the demerger of Hanson Plc
S&P said the Peabody Finance commercial paper programme will replace the Peabody Australia Holdings Ltd commercial paper programme once it matures on March 27.
